description: This file defines the NetworkFirewallClient class, which serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Network Firewall service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and updating firewalls, policies, and rule groups, as well as their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: NetworkFirewallClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Network Firewall service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: associateFirewallPolicy
methods.description: Associates a firewall policy with a resource.

methods.name: associateFirewallPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a firewall policy with a resource.

methods.name: describeFirewall
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific firewall.

methods.name: describeFirewallAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific firewall.

methods.name: updateFirewallDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a firewall.

methods.name: updateFirewallDescriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the description of a firewall.
